aboutDescription: A tool to calculate each plant's carbon footprint from its consumption: fuels, refrigerants, electricity, employee commuting, business travel and waste.
aboutDescriptionExtra: Works offline and installs on a phone. With the central registry connected, every entry is saved to the Georgalos spreadsheet with date and user, and everyone sees every plant's data.
methodScopes: Follows the GHG Protocol: Scope 1 (on-site combustion, company vehicles and refrigerant leaks), Scope 2 (purchased electricity, location-based) and Scope 3 (employee commuting – category 7, business travel – category 6, waste – category 5).
methodGwp: Global warming potentials: {gwp} (CH₄ = {ch4}, N₂O = {n2o}), the same used by Argentina's National GHG Inventory.
methodBiogenic: Biogenic CO₂ from biofuel blends (bioethanol in gasoline, biodiesel in diesel) is excluded from the scopes, as the GHG Protocol requires.
methodCommute: Commuting: people × km per trip × 2 (round trip) × days worked × mode factor. Car factors are per vehicle-km and are divided by people per car.
disclaimer: Factors are updated whenever a new National Inventory is published. The grid factor is for 2022, the latest published. Per-km transport factors are UK values (there are no official Argentine per-km factors); review them if you seek certification. This tool gives a management estimate and does not replace an ISO 14064 verification.
creditsText: Based on the open-source Carbon Calculator project (MIT license), developed by students of TFO "Max Valier" in Bolzano under Erasmus+. Adapted for industrial plants in Argentina.
